name: Process: Run the requisite-variety pass at every gate
text_content:
P8, P13, and I2. The pre-opening pass on the S8 page maps Session 3's eight disturbance classes to their regulators against the actual leadership-line list, names the two partial holes (the kitchen before the ruling, a stack outage mid-service), the three parts resolving to a founder (the threshold's value, the bandwidth order, the brand crisis), and the four classes converging on the Maitre d's seat. The process: the pass is re-run at every period's gate against the new configuration and after dinner's first quarter against the shift-close log; a leadership line is added only when the pass shows a class resolving to nothing or to a founder by default, argued and ratified before the period opens; no line is added by assumption; the line count is a stated gap until the chef fills the Station Leads; the check-in load per lead is the first reading at the mechanism reset. Blocks row 97 and every period's gate. High.

Filed by Session 8 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhxx. Reasoning lives on the S8 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
